hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central Europe, east of Germany || mostly flat plain; mountains along southern border || historically an area of conflict because of flat terrain and the lack of natural barriers on the North European Plain || Resources: coal, sulfur, copper, natural gas, silver, lead, salt, amber, arable land || Exports: vehicle parts/accessories, electric batteries, plastic products, cars, seats (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly flat plain; mountains along southern border || Central Europe, east of Germany

climate.excerpt: temperate with cold, cloudy, moderately severe winters with frequent precipitation; mild summers with frequent showers and thundershowers || flooding

economy.excerpt: high-income, diversified, EU-member economy; significant growth in GDP, trade, and investment since joining EU in 2004; private consumption and EU-funded public investments driving GDP growth; increased social spending, flooding recovery costs, and defense spending have added to public debt || Exports: vehicle parts/accessories, electric batteries, plastic products, cars, seats (2023) || Industries: machine building, iron and steel, coal mining, chemicals, shipbuilding, food processing, glass, beverages, textiles
